trigger: Contingency design persisted before C4 density results are complete. C3b showed severe off-grid dry-to-wet tail errors in head-by-head bilinear interpolation while the equal-flux interface construction itself remained sound.

scientific_donor.citation: Ross PJ (2011), Numerical Solution of the Continuity Equation for Soil Water Flow Using Precomputed Steady-State Fluxes, Vadose Zone Journal 10:760-766
scientific_donor.relevant_idea: Use water content as table state in unsaturated cells and matric head in saturated cells, with precomputed steady-Darcian flux tables. This is a representation idea only; LayeredMFP temporal update semantics remain separate from RossFast.

hypothesis: The extreme C3b errors may be caused primarily by poor head-space interpolation geometry across many decades of suction, not by the existence of a two-endpoint steady-flux response itself. A bounded mixed-state coordinate may regularize the unsaturated dry tail without brute-force global head-axis density.

precommitted_candidate_family.unsaturated_endpoint_coordinate: effective saturation S_e=(theta-theta_r)/(theta_s-theta_r), evaluated from the shared SWAP hydraulic material; theta itself remains an equivalent candidate only if material-local scaling is preferable
precommitted_candidate_family.hydraulic_physics: same direct steady-Darcian face oracle and same SWAP constitutive functions as the reference; no solver-specific hydraulic law
representation_candidates: constrained residual/correction around the existing MFP face closure using the same mixed endpoint coordinates
precommitted_candidate_family.runtime_lookup_target: bounded O(1) interpolation per face plus any separately bounded heterogeneous equal-flux scalar solve

physical_identities_to_preserve: continuous sign change through zero flux
single realized face flux used with opposite signs in adjacent balances
explicit fail-closed behavior outside admitted coordinate/state envelope

methodology.C3b_use: revealed C3b probes may be used only for representation characterization and comparison with the failed head-by-head family
methodology.qualification_holdout: any promoted C5 candidate requires a new independently precommitted C5b off-grid holdout before qualification
methodology.thresholds: reuse existing face-error, sign, continuity and identity thresholds; do not relax after seeing results
methodology.C4_role: C4 must still finish because it determines whether brute-force head-axis density is viable and provides a cost/convergence baseline

cross_track_boundary.shared_with_RossFast: steady-Darcian face-reference science and possibly immutable path-table data structures may be shared behind a solver-neutral hydraulic-face provider
cross_track_boundary.not_shared: RossFast tridiagonal time integration and LayeredMFP conservative reduced-order layer update remain distinct solver algorithms

decision_rules.if_C4_converges_rapidly_at_bounded_cost: C5 remains an alternative representation study, not automatically preferred
decision_rules.if_C4_converges_slowly_or_requires_exces: prioritize C5 characterization over further global head-axis density escalation
decision_rules.if_C5_also_has_severe_offgrid_tail_error: stop generic 2-D interpolation escalation and investigate a local steady-Darcian face solve or a narrower scientifically defined LayeredMFP envelope
